head.t: Embecta shares jump as Owen Mumford acquisition lifts quarterly revenue
head.x: Embecta, which bought UK device maker Owen Mumford this year, reported fiscal fourth-quarter revenue of $298.7m, up 13.1%, with Owen Mumford contributing $27.6m.

head.t: Framework ending 12 October 2027: Blood Collection Devices
head.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "Owen Mumford Ltd". 19 suppliers on the framework.

head.t: Framework ending 30 June 2027: Maternity, Obstetrics, Gynaecology and Sexual Health Products
head.x: Named on NHS Supply Chain's own contract launch brief for this framework, as "Owen Mumford Limited". 57 suppliers on the framework.
